subject: Invoice shows the wrong company name
body: Our latest invoice has our old legal entity name on it. Accounting rejected it. Can you reissue it with the correct name?

subject: Card was declined, now getting dunning emails
body: Our corporate card expired and the payment failed. We updated the card yesterday but we still get dunning emails and the banner says the workspace will be downgraded.

subject: Want to cancel and get a refund, still in trial window
body: We started 9 days ago and only used a small part of the quota. We would like to cancel and get our money back.

subject: Cannot log in, 2FA codes never arrive
body: Nobody on our team can log in. The two-factor SMS codes never arrive and one account is now locked. We cannot use the product at all right now.

subject: Hitting 429 on our production integration
body: We are getting HTTP 429 with Retry-After during peak hours. Our sync job fails and we fall behind. Default limit of 600 per minute is not enough for us.

subject: How do I rotate an API key without breaking production?
body: We think a key was shared in a screenshot. What is the safe order to rotate it so our services keep running?

subject: Unauthorized login from an unknown IP
body: We see a login from a country we do not operate in, and the user says they did not do it. This looks like account takeover. Please help immediately.

subject: Charged twice this month
body: Our bank statement shows two charges of the same amount on the same day. Invoice number INV-88421. Please refund the duplicate.

subject: Annual plan refund request after 45 days
body: We bought the annual plan 45 days ago and the team stopped using it after a reorg. Can we get a prorated refund for the remaining months?

subject: Transfer workspace ownership to a new admin
body: Our previous owner left the company. How do we transfer ownership to the new IT lead?

subject: Webhook deliveries are failing
body: Every webhook delivery is marked failed. Our endpoint sometimes takes 8 seconds to respond. Do we need to change something on our side?

subject: Feature request: dark mode for the dashboard
body: Our team works late and the bright dashboard is hard on the eyes. Any chance of a dark theme?

subject: Please delete all our data, GDPR request
body: Under GDPR we request deletion of all workspace data for our account. Please confirm in writing when it is complete.

subject: Billing page is down and we cannot use the product
body: The billing and admin pages return 500 for every user in our workspace. All users affected. We cannot use the product right now and we have a board meeting in two hours.

subject: We filed a chargeback and now the workspace is suspended
body: Our finance team disputed the last charge because the invoice was wrong. Now the workspace is suspended. We want it back today.

subject: Sandbox API key does not work against production
body: I generated a key in the sandbox and our staging service gets 401 against the production endpoint. Is there a separate key per environment?

subject: CSV export of workspace data is taking forever
body: I started an export two days ago and the download link expired. The workspace is large. Is there a faster way?

subject: Can I speak to a human about enterprise pricing
body: We are evaluating vendors and I would rather talk to a real person than read docs. Please have someone contact me.

subject: Need the VAT ID added to last month's invoice
body: Our finance department needs our VAT number on the invoice issued last month so we can self-assess VAT. Is that possible?

subject: API returning 500 for every request in production
body: All customers are affected. Every API call returns 500 since 09:12 UTC. This is a production outage for us and our status page is red.
